```{r sample-qc-section, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(params$qc_out)) {
  cat("\n\n## Sample QC\n\n")
  cat("\n\nPer-sample detection depth on the **input** count matrix (before gene filtering): ",
      "detected genes = genes with count > 0; total transcripts = sum of counts.\n\n", sep = "")
  sq <- params$qc_out$sample_qc_table
  if (!is.null(sq) && nrow(sq)) {
    show <- sq
    show$n_total_transcripts <- format(show$n_total_transcripts, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE)
    print(knitr::kable(show,
                        col.names = c("Sample", "Detected genes", "Total transcripts"),
                        row.names = FALSE))
    cat("\n\n")
    DEGreports::emit_widget(
      DEGreports::link_output_file("qc_sample_summary.csv", label = "Download sample QC CSV")
    )
  } else {
    cat("\n\nSample QC table was not available for this run.\n\n")
  }
}
```

```{r qc-section, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(params$qc_out)) {
  cat("\n\n## Library QC\n\n")
  cat("\n\nGenes removed at each QC step:\n\n")
  steps_df <- params$qc_out$steps_summary
  steps_df$pct_removed <- paste0(formatC(steps_df$pct_removed, format = "f", digits = 2), "%")
  print(knitr::kable(steps_df,
                      col.names = c("Step", "Genes before", "Genes removed", "% removed", "Genes after"),
                      row.names = FALSE))

  filter_method <- params$qc_out$filter_method
  if (is.null(filter_method)) {
    cat("\n\nLow-expression filter: **none applied** (`filter_method = NULL`). ",
        "Enable one with `filter_method = \"cpm\"` (percentile-based) or ",
        "`filter_method = \"count\"` (per-group absolute threshold) in `run_qc()` ",
        "(or `run_deseq2()`).\n\n", sep = "")
  } else if (identical(filter_method, "cpm")) {
    cat("\n\nLow-expression filter: removed every gene with no reads in any sample, ",
        "then the bottom **", round(params$qc_out$cpm_percentile * 100, 2),
        "%** of the remaining (expressed) genes by mean CPM across samples.\n\n", sep = "")
  } else {
    cat("\n\nLow-expression filter: keep a gene if, in at least one group, \u2265 **",
        params$qc_out$min_samples_per_group, "** sample(s) have a raw count \u2265 **",
        params$qc_out$min_count, "**. Adjust via the `min_count`/`min_samples_per_group` ",
        "arguments to `run_qc()` (or `run_deseq2()`); switch to the percentile-based ",
        "filter with `filter_method = \"cpm\"`.\n\n",
        sep = "")
  }

  DEGreports::emit_code_block(
    caption = "Reproduce library QC with this package module:",
    "dds_qc <- run_qc(dds, var = \"condition\", filter_method = \"cpm\")"
  )

  cat("\n\n### Count distribution\n\n")
  cat("\n\nDistribution of the per-gene filtering statistic before and after low-expression removal, ",
      "overlaid on the same axes. The dashed line marks the expression cutoff.\n\n")
}
```

## PCA

```{r pca-methods, results='asis'}
DEGreports::emit_code_block(
  caption = "Reproduce PCA + sample similarity with this package module:",
  "distance_out <- run_distance_pca(dds_qc, var = \"condition\")"
)
```

### PCA scatter {.tabset}

```{r pca-has-batch, include=FALSE}
# Keyed on the static plot, since the interactive one is NULL whenever plotly
# could not convert it (see make_interactive()).
pca_has_batch <- !is.null(params$distance_out$pca_plot_uncorrected)
# Name the method in the tab labels, so a reader can tell a ComBat-seq report
# from a ComBat one. Falls back to the generic wording when no batch was given.
corr_method <- params$distance_out$batch_correction
if (is.null(corr_method) || !nzchar(corr_method) || identical(corr_method, "none")) {
  corr_method <- "batch correction"
}
after_tab <- paste("After", corr_method)
# The "before" side is the same uncorrected VST matrix whichever method the
# "after" side used, so it stays generically named.
before_tab <- "Before batch correction"
loadings_size <- DEGreports::pca_loadings_figure_size()
```

```{r pca-after-tab, results='asis'}
cat("\n\n#### ", after_tab, "\n\n", sep = "")
```

```{r pca-after-heading, results='asis'}
if (pca_has_batch) {
  cat("\n\nHover over a point to see its sample name. PCA/scree/loadings below are all ",
      "computed on the batch-corrected matrix; batch correction is for visualization only ",
      "and does not alter the DESeq2 design or differential expression results.\n\n", sep = "")
} else {
  cat("\n\nNo batch correction was applied (`batch = NULL`); this is simply the PCA on the ",
      "variance-stabilized matrix. See the \"", before_tab, "\" tab for the identical data.\n\n", sep = "")
}
```

```{r pca-assoc-heading, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$distance_out$pca_assoc_plot)}
cat("\n\n### PC–covariate association {.tabset}\n\n")
cat("\n\nAssociation of the top 15 PC scores with sample covariates ",
    "(`batch`, grouping `var`, and `time` when present for LRT). ",
    "Colour = ", "-log10(p)", " from ANOVA (factors) or Pearson correlation (numeric); ",
    "numbers are shown only for associations with p < 0.05.\n\n", sep = "")
```

```{r pca-assoc-helpers, include=FALSE}
emit_pca_assoc_heatmap <- function(hm, assoc_df, filename) {
  if (is.null(hm)) return(invisible(NULL))
  buttons <- if (is.null(assoc_df)) {
    list()
  } else {
    list(DEGreports::download_table_button(as.data.frame(assoc_df), filename = filename))
  }
  # Shown at its own aspect ratio so the cell text is not squashed, and
  # allowed to shrink with a narrow report panel.
  DEGreports::emit_heatmap_with_download(
    hm, filename = filename, buttons = buttons,
    scale = 0.875, responsive = TRUE
  )
}
```

### Sample similarity (Spearman) {.tabset}

Pairwise Spearman correlation between samples (colour scale spans the actual
min/max off-diagonal correlation observed in this matrix; darker red = more
similar, darker blue = less similar). The self-correlation diagonal carries no
information and is blanked out (dark grey).

```{r sim-helpers, include=FALSE}
sim_has_combat <- !is.null(params$distance_out$similarity_plot_corrected)
sim_method <- corr_method

emit_sample_similarity_heatmap <- function(hm, cor_df, filename, table_filename) {
  if (is.null(hm)) return(invisible(NULL))
  buttons <- if (is.null(cor_df)) {
    list()
  } else {
    list(DEGreports::download_table_button(as.data.frame(cor_df), filename = table_filename))
  }
  DEGreports::emit_heatmap_with_download(
    hm, filename = filename, buttons = buttons, max_width = 10, max_height = 10
  )
}
```

```{r dist-heatmap-after-tab, results='asis'}
cat("\n\n#### ", after_tab, "\n\n", sep = "")
```

```{r dist-heatmap-after, results='asis'}
if (sim_has_combat) {
  cat("\n\nSpearman correlation after **", sim_method, "** (protecting the ",
      "biological grouping variable). This is the same corrected matrix used for ",
      "the PCA above and for the sample-level modules (WGCNA, GSVA, VIPER, ",
      "decoupleR).\n\n", sep = "")
  emit_sample_similarity_heatmap(
    params$distance_out$similarity_plot_corrected,
    params$distance_out$similarity_matrix_corrected,
    "sample_similarity_heatmap_batch_corrected",
    "sample_similarity_matrix_batch_corrected"
  )
} else {
  cat("\n\nNo batch column was supplied (`batch = NULL`); this is the Spearman heatmap ",
      "on the uncorrected VST matrix. The \"Before (VST)\" tab is identical.\n\n", sep = "")
  emit_sample_similarity_heatmap(
    params$distance_out$similarity_plot,
    params$distance_out$similarity_matrix,
    "sample_similarity_heatmap",
    "sample_similarity_matrix"
  )
}
```

